text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I could cuddle this forever… It's so soft. And extremely cute.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Imagine if it started moving… I'd love to see that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um… Thank you very much. I'll treasure it.
